bio.text: Phil Mendelson is Chairman of the Council of the District of Columbia; he was first elected to the Council as an At-Large member in November 1998.
In June 2012 his colleagues selected him as Chairman after the resignation of the previous chairman, and voters elected him to the post in 2012, 2014, 2018 and 2022.
He was an Advisory Neighborhood Commissioner from 1979 until he took office on the Council, and chaired the Council's Committee on the Judiciary from 2005 to 2012.
Mendelson came to Washington from Cleveland, Ohio, in 1970 and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from American University.
